verdict.rationale: Stripe documents instant bank-account verification for ACH payments and an 'instant' mode that uses Financial Connections only, with no microdeposit fallback. A beta integrator independently confirms using it for instant account verification on ACH payments. However, the evidence never explicitly shows how a developer obtains the verified account and routing numbers or a tokenized payment-method equivalent from the linked account. missing for 10: explicit documentation of retrieving verified account/routing numbers or a tokenized PaymentMethod from a linked account, and detail on how that payment method is attached to fund ACH debits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can obtain verified account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) from a linked account to fund ACH or bank-debit payments without micro-deposits

citations.quote: You can use one integration to instantly verify bank accounts for ACH payments
instant | Financial Connections only, with no manual entry and microdeposit fallback
Collect a bank account for ACH Direct Debit payments while using account data, including balances.
We use the link to bank accounts for instant account verification and as a fraud signal for ACH payments.
